# Fixture

An external URL whose path happens to carry an ordinal is not a citation into this
corpus: https://example.com/standards/ADR-9999 — and the `<repo>:` form cannot be
written inside a URL, so an error here would have no legal fix.

A markdown destination is a path too, checked by R15 rather than R8: see
[the upstream note](https://example.example/adr/ADR-8888).

Link *text* is prose and stays checked, which is why [ADR-0001](adr/0001-alpha.md)
resolves here.
